timely.label: Gas Prices
timely.line: Missouri's average for regular gas is $3.91 today, down 26 cents from a month ago but up $1.22 from a year ago, according to AAA. Springfield averages $3.91 too. Your wallet remembers last year.

timely.label: Turkey Season
timely.line: Fall firearms turkey season ends Saturday, Oct. 31, in 3 days. Last call for gobblers.

timely.label: Halloween
timely.line: Halloween is Saturday, Oct. 31, in 3 days. Somebody's already eating the candy bowl.

timely.label: Fall Back
timely.line: Daylight saving time ends Sunday, Nov. 1, in 4 days, so clocks fall back one hour and sunset comes an hour earlier. Spend that extra hour wisely, or just sleep.

timely.label: Archery Season
timely.line: Archery deer season ends Friday, Nov. 13, in 16 days. Time's ticking, and so is your stand.

timely.label: Firearms Season
timely.line: The November portion of firearms deer season opens Saturday, Nov. 14, in 17 days, and runs through Nov. 24. Time to dig out the blaze orange.

timely.label: Archery Returns
timely.line: Archery deer season opens Wednesday, Nov. 25, in 28 days, and runs through Jan. 15. Bowhunters get a second chance.

timely.label: Youth Season
timely.line: Youth firearms deer season opens Friday, Nov. 27, in 30 days, and runs through Nov. 29. Better start shopping for kid-sized orange.

timely.label: Dove Season
timely.line: Dove season ends Sunday, Nov. 29, in 32 days. Plenty of time to miss a few more.

timely.label: Thanksgiving
timely.line: Thanksgiving is Thursday, Nov. 26, in 29 days. Start stretching those stretchy pants.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Queen released 'News of the World' in 1977, with 'We Will Rock You' and 'We Are the Champions,' now fixtures at sports events. Stomp, stomp, clap, repeat.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: 'Islands in the Stream' by Kenny Rogers and Dolly Parton hit No. 1 in 1983. Still the karaoke duet nobody sings well.

timely.label: Sports Anniversary
timely.line: LeBron James made his NBA debut in 2003 with 25 points, nine assists and six rebounds, even in a loss. Not a bad first day at work.

timely.label: Music Anniversary
timely.line: Men at Work hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 with 'Who Can It Be Now?' in 1982. Sounds like your doorbell this Halloween.

timely.label: Movie Night
timely.line: The Cat in the Hat, an animated movie with Bill Hader voicing the Cat, opens Friday, Nov. 6. Hats off to family movie night.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Hamax Buddy child bike seats sold at Décathlon are recalled over a choking hazard, so check the harness straps. Worth two minutes in the garage.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Plastic Balloons balloon blowing kits are recalled because some contain hidden chemical risks. Skip the kit and keep the party.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Adults who took part in a supplemental Head Start program as preschoolers reported better mental health and social adjustment nearly two decades later. Sharing the crayons pays off.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad asks parents to stop driving to the 'nice' neighborhoods to trick-or-treat, saying all three neighborhoods he has lived in were safe and walkable. Your own block has candy too.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: Scary Mommy rounded up 10 make-ahead Thanksgiving sides that reheat well, so nobody's stuck in the kitchen while family hangs out in the living room. Kitchen jail avoided.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes' ham and bean soup is chunky and easy, loaded with colorful vegetables, browned ham and plenty of white beans. Fall dinner, solved.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: The Kitchn's apple cobbler cooks the apple filling on the stovetop first so it softens and releases juices, and the topping is super easy to whisk. Cobbler beats pie on effort.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste's baked Southwest turkey meatballs use lean ground turkey, jalapeño, cilantro, garlic and cumin, and they're easy to make ahead for dipping. Meatball Monday, sorted.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Starting in March, camping on Missouri Department of Conservation areas takes a $5 permit, good for up to five days and 10 people, bought online. Five bucks for a campsite is still a deal.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Starting in March 2027, the Missouri Department of Conservation will require permits to use its unstaffed firearms shooting ranges because of increasing damage. Range etiquette, now with paperwork.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Bath & Body Works advent calendar signups open Nov. 4: $50 for more than $115 in products, seven of them sold only inside the box. Plan your stocking now.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Firehouse Subs is selling $9.95 plushies, each honoring a real rescue dog, with 100 percent of profits buying lifesaving equipment for first responders. Cuddly and useful.
